# Global Chip Supply Remains Severe, Prices Accelerate Fast  
**Bottom line:** Supply risk sits at 79 / 100 and price trend at 94 / 100, leaving little room for price concessions this week.

## What changed
- Overall market supply risk unchanged at 78.7 (Severe) and price trend unchanged at 94.3 (Rising fast) [1][2].  
- Producer price index (+9.1 % annualized over 3 mo) continues to push both supply tightness and price hikes across all segments [1].  
- Trade‑press tone stays strongly upward for price (+1.00 net) and supply (+0.91 net), reinforcing the same directional bias [2].  
- Global chip sales surged 146.1 % YoY to $159.7 B in Aug 2026, confirming demand‑driven pressure on both supply and pricing [3].

## Segment board
- **Processors & advanced logic:** supply 76.9 (Severe, ↔), price 83.8 (Rising fast), confidence High.  
- **Memory (DRAM/NAND/HBM):** supply 79.5 (Severe, ↔), price 95.6 (Rising fast), confidence High.  
- **Analog & power mgmt:** supply 73.0 (Elevated, ↔), price 92.0 (Rising fast), confidence High.  
- **Microcontrollers & embedded:** supply 75.5 (Severe, ↔), price 90.9 (Rising fast), confidence High.  
- **Power discretes (MOSFET/IGBT/SiC/GaN):** supply 70.4 (Elevated, ↔), price 90.6 (Rising fast), confidence High.

## Your BOM watchlist
- **W25Q128JVSIQ (memory):** supply risk 86.2 / 100; 52‑week lead time vs ~12‑week norm.  
- **MT25QL128ABA1EW9‑0SIT (memory):** supply risk 86.1 / 100; 52‑week lead time; price 1,717 % above target.  
- **MT40A1G16TB‑062E:F (memory):** supply risk 86.1 / 100; 52‑week lead time; price 4,556 % above target.  
- **10M08SAE144C8G (logic):** supply risk 84.9 / 100; 52‑week lead time; price 129 % above target.  
- **XC7A35T‑1CSG324C (logic):** supply risk 84.9 / 100; 52‑week lead time; price 60 % above target.

## Outlook
- **Chip prices (next 3 mo):** 66 % chance of rise, expected +2.2 % (80 % range ‑9.6 % → +13.9 %); model‑tested edge [forecast 1].  
- **Chip prices (next 6 mo):** 52 % chance of rise, expected +4.3 % (80 % range ‑8.8 % → +17.5 %); baseline trend‑following [forecast 2].  
- **Fab utilization (next 3 mo):** 63 % chance of tighter supply, expected +1.8 pts (80 % range ‑1.7 → +5.4 pts); baseline trend [forecast 3].  
- **Fab utilization (next 6 mo):** 60 % chance of tighter supply, expected +3.6 pts (80 % range ‑2.2 → +9.5 pts); baseline trend [forecast 4].

## Negotiation angle
1. **Lock‑in long‑lead‑time memory parts now** – the five watchlist memory SKUs show 52‑week lead times and price premiums > 100 %; securing volume commitments can avoid further escalation.  
2. **Leverage the unchanged supply risk score** – with supply risk flat at 79, suppliers have limited justification for additional price hikes; push for price caps tied to future lead‑time improvements.  
3. **Tie pricing to utilization forecasts** – cite the 63 % probability of tighter fab utilization in the next quarter; request volume‑based rebates if utilization exceeds the 1.8‑point uplift forecast.
